newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia late rubber steady on fresh enquiries.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia late rubber steady on fresh enquiries.

text.p: Indonesian benchmark tyre-grade SIR20 offer prices were steady in late trading on Monday on the back of fresh enquiries mainly from Europe, dealers said.
"SIR20 remains steady on some fresh enquiries from European firms, which appear to be active after the summer holiday on the continent," one Jakarta-based dealer said.

Dealers said SIR20 offer prices for October/November deliveries were at 57.25-57.75 U.S. cents/lb fob Medan and at 57.00-57.50 cents fob Palembang, Surabaya and Padang, and at 56.75-57.25 cents fob Jambi and Pontianak.
One SIR3L dealer in the north Sumatran city of Medan said the shoe-grade rubber was not much affected by the talk of lower supply due to heavy rains.

"The lower supply talk only affects SIR20, which is mostly produced by small rubber growers, and not other types of rubber such as SIR3L and SIRCV, which are produced mainly by large firms," the SIR3L dealer said.
One Jakarta-based dealer said SIR20 was last traded late on Friday at 56.75 cents/lb fob Palembang for November deliveries.
